# Format 0x03 redis_kv_* record encodings (redis-general-data-types task 1).
# Regenerate with KYTHIRA_UPDATE_GOLDENS=1; a change here is a log-entry
# format change.
command exec INCR
  030800000007636f756e746572001f000001b8dac5b400000000000100000007
  636f756e7465720000000101
  key=counter
command exec SET NX PXAT under the immutable rule
  0308000000046c6f636b0002000001b8dac5b4000100000005000000046c6f63
  6b000000056f776e6572000000024e5800000004505841540000000d31373637
  3232353630303530300000000100
  key=lock
command exec binary argument
  03080000000168003b000001b8dac5b400000000000300000001680000000661
  0d0a0062ff000000000000000101
  key=h
command exec no keys, no arguments
  03080000000000130000000000000000000000000000000000
  key=
command exec nine keys
  0308000000026b31002c000001b8dac5b4000000000009000000026b31000000
  026b32000000026b33000000026b34000000026b35000000026b36000000026b
  37000000026b38000000026b3900000002a501
  key=k1
command range_delete prefix
  030900000004746d702f00000004746d702f00000004746d7030000003e8
  key=tmp/
command range_delete to the end
  03090000000161000000016100000000ffffffff
  key=a
command format_gate
  030a00000001670003
  key=g
command remove_members none
  030b000000017300000000
  key=s
command remove_members two
  030b000000017300000002000000026d3100000006610d0a0062ff
  key=s
